context: The skill should give an Optional upsert one present/absent boundary with the present-branch policy in a named helper.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible WaitingCommentSync code with imports, logger, methods, and records intact.

checklist.name: Uses one Optional decision boundary
checklist.description: Consumes prerequisiteWaitingComment(config, card.id()) once with ifPresentOrElse or an equivalent single present/absent boundary instead of two pipelines over the same Optional.

checklist.name: Extracts present-branch policy
checklist.description: Moves the same-text no-op, blank-id create, and update decisions into a named helper or an equally clear method boundary.

checklist.name: Preserves side-effect behavior
checklist.description: Keeps absent create, same-text no-op, different-text update when the id is nonblank, different-text create when the id is blank, and the original add/update arguments.

checklist.name: Keeps exception boundary
checklist.description: Keeps runtime exception handling around the upsert operation and preserves the warning.

checklist.name: Avoids Optional antipatterns
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), isPresent plus get, generic helpers, or fake collections.

checklist.name: Keeps code focused
checklist.description: Does not redesign logging, comments, config, or repository access beyond clarifying the upsert flow.
